image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a car wheel attached to a red vehicle. The wheel features a polished silver/chrome multi-spoke alloy rim with a deep dish design. A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim, showing visible sidewall lettering ('COOPER COBRA') and tread details. The central hub has a single large nut/bolt cover rather than standard lug holes, suggesting a custom or racing setup. Behind the spokes, brake calipers and rotors are visible. The background includes the red fender of the car and asphalt ground.
